This is a UIAO JSON Schema, rendered as a developer-reference page per
[ADR-072](../../adr/adr-072-canon-publication-policy.qmd).

- **Source:** [`src/uiao/schemas/locpath/duty-station-map.schema.json`](../../../src/uiao/schemas/locpath/duty-station-map.schema.json)
- **Dialect:** `https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema`
- **`$id`:** `https://uiao.io/schemas/locpath/duty-station-map.schema.json`
:::

## Description

The HR duty-station to LocPath mapping table (ADR-102 §D3/§D6 / UIAO_194 §The two-layer location model). Translates the HR system of record's location codes (Spec2-D1.1 `locationCode`) into canonical LocPath values from a location registry. Code uniqueness (case-insensitive), target-node existence, and the Site-or-deeper rule are enforced at load time by uiao.modernization.locpath, not in JSON Schema. The 'reference' map shipped as executable canon pairs with the 'reference' location registry — agency maps are loaded from their own paths with the same contract.

## Top-Level Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `schema_version` | string | ✓ | Duty-station-map schema version. Major pinned to 1. |
| `document_id` | `const: 'UIAO_194'` | ✓ | Duty-station maps are executable canon under the UIAO_194 allocation, alongside the location registry. |
| `map_id` | string | ✓ | Kebab-case stable identifier. 'reference' is the canonical worked example shipped with the substrate; agency maps use their own ids. |
| `display_name` | string | ✓ |  |
| `status` | enum: 'reference', 'proposed', 'active', 'deprecated' | ✓ | reference = the canonical worked example; proposed = specified, not yet authoritative; active = the governed duty-station map of record; deprecated = retiring, must name successor. |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `updated` | string | ✓ | Date of last governed change to this map. |
| `entries` | array&lt;object&gt; | ✓ | Duty-station code to LocPath mappings. Each target locPath must resolve in the paired location registry at Site level or deeper (ADR-102 §D1: Site is the minimum governance unit). |

## Full Schema

```{.json filename="duty-station-map.schema.json"}
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://uiao.io/schemas/locpath/duty-station-map.schema.json",
  "title": "UIAO LocPath Duty-Station Map",
  "description": "The HR duty-station to LocPath mapping table (ADR-102 \u00a7D3/\u00a7D6 / UIAO_194 \u00a7The two-layer location model). Translates the HR system of record's location codes (Spec2-D1.1 `locationCode`) into canonical LocPath values from a location registry. Code uniqueness (case-insensitive), target-node existence, and the Site-or-deeper rule are enforced at load time by uiao.modernization.locpath, not in JSON Schema. The 'reference' map shipped as executable canon pairs with the 'reference' location registry \u2014 agency maps are loaded from their own paths with the same contract.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "schema_version",
    "document_id",
    "map_id",
    "display_name",
    "status",
    "updated",
    "entries"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^1\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$",
      "description": "Duty-station-map schema version. Major pinned to 1."
    },
    "document_id": {
      "const": "UIAO_194",
      "description": "Duty-station maps are executable canon under the UIAO_194 allocation, alongside the location registry."
    },
    "map_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$",
      "description": "Kebab-case stable identifier. 'reference' is the canonical worked example shipped with the substrate; agency maps use their own ids."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "reference",
        "proposed",
        "active",
        "deprecated"
      ],
      "description": "reference = the canonical worked example; proposed = specified, not yet authoritative; active = the governed duty-station map of record; deprecated = retiring, must name successor."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "updated": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "Date of last governed change to this map."
    },
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Duty-station code to LocPath mappings. Each target locPath must resolve in the paired location registry at Site level or deeper (ADR-102 \u00a7D1: Site is the minimum governance unit).",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "locationCode",
          "locPath"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "locationCode": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$",
            "description": "The HR system of record's duty-station / work-location code (Spec2-D1.1 `locationCode`). Matched case-insensitively."
          },
          "locPath": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)(/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*$",
            "description": "Canonical LocPath the code resolves to. Must exist in the paired location registry at Site level or deeper."
          },
          "description": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
